name: Meta lead in
about: New lead from Meta Lead Ads goes into the CRM. Duplicates (same mobile) become a note on the existing lead. Form answers are kept as lead fields (Experience, Background, Fee plan, Ad set, Ad name); a new campaign name is added to Campaigns automatically.

body.course: {{trigger.<question: Which program are you interested in?>}}

custom.experience: {{trigger.<question: Do you have a minimum of 3 years of professional work experience?>}}
custom.background: {{trigger.<question: What is your current professional background?>}}
custom.fee_plan: {{trigger.<question: The course fee is ₹3.5 Lakhs … after placement?>}}

settings.failure: Retry 3 times, then notify the admin by email

notes: Send one test lead with Meta's Lead Ads Testing Tool first: Activepieces then lists every field of the form; pick each <question …> from that list.

Long answers are fine: 'Yes, I have 5–8 years of experience.' is saved as Experience '5-8 years'; 'Currently on a career break' as Background 'Career break'; 'I'd like to know more.' as Fee plan 'Know more'.
Course: 'Python Development' matches a CRM course named 'Python'; 'Need career guidance' (no course) is kept as the course text so the telecaller sees it.
If a form field is empty or missing, it is simply left out; the lead is still created.
